use_case_name: Monitor Current and Past Auction Status

claims.content: Allow the customer to view and monitor the status of current and past auctions, including bid history, watch lists, recently ended auctions, and account details.

goal.raw_text: Allow the customer to view and monitor the status of current and past auctions, including bid history, watch lists, recently ended auctions, and account details.

claims.content: Customer
The customer has registered for an account on the jtvauctions.com website.
The customer is logged into their account (has a valid session).
The customer navigates to the 'My Current Bids', 'My Bid History', 'My Watch List', or 'Recently Ended Auctions' pages from their account dashboard.

trigger.raw_text: The customer navigates to the 'My Current Bids', 'My Bid History', 'My Watch List', or 'Recently Ended Auctions' pages from their account dashboard.

claims.content: The customer navigates to the 'My Account Page' from the website.
From the 'My Account Page', the customer selects a specific monitoring option such as 'My Current Bids', 'My Bid History', 'My Watch List', or 'Recently Ended Auctions'.
The system displays the requested list of auction items corresponding to the selected category (e.g., current bids, bid history).
The customer reviews the status details of the auctions, including product descriptions, bid amounts, and auction end times.

If the customer selects 'My Account Edit Page' from the 'My Account Page', the system allows the customer to view and edit their account details across multiple pages (Page 1, Page 2, Page 3, Page 4).
If the customer attempts to access auction details or bidding functions without being signed in, the system directs them to the 'Sign-in Page'.
If the customer searches for items and no results are found, the system displays the 'No Results Search Page'.

The customer has successfully viewed their account details via one of the 'My Account Edit Page' options (Page 1 through Page 4).

If the customer accessed detailed performance metrics, the system displays a report containing data such as 'Total Items Bid On', 'Gross Items Won', 'Gross Winnings', 'Cancelled Orders', and 'Return Rate'.
